_why.src/fleetMailbox.js: maxPartnerMtime is a stored data field name (result key read by the renderer and tests), not wording; renaming needs a data migration
_why.src/overview.js: needsOwner is the task store's wire-format field name (also written by tasks.py), not a name shown or sent to anyone; renaming it needs a contract change with the task tool.
_why.src/daily/contract.js: My Daily's STORED names (task field, calendar ids, appointment/settings keys, the tasks.py flag). Renaming them would stop existing data from loading, so they stay as contract constants in this one file; nothing else in My Daily spells them.
_why.src/renderer/daily-contract.js: The renderer's copy of the same stored ids and keys (appointment field, settings key, calendar ids). Same reason as src/daily/contract.js.
_why.src/argus-data.js: worthOwnerKnowing is a field NAME in the research digest files agents already wrote (data schema); the new name worthKnowing is accepted too. Remove when every writer has switched.
_why.src/renderer/argus.js: needsOwner is the task store's wire-format field name in the status files (also written by tasks.py), not a name shown to anyone.
_why.src/dep-doctor.js: Windows system fallbacks (Program Files npm.cmd, System32 cmd.exe) used only when ComSpec / PATH lookup finds nothing; these are the OS's own fixed locations, not a user's folders.
_why.src/main.js: ComSpec fallback to the Windows System32 cmd.exe (OS fixed location). Everything else in main.js code (strings, logic) is scanned with comments ignored.
_why.src/research/service.js: worthOwnerKnowing is a field NAME in the research digest files agents already wrote (data schema), read here; same reason as src/argus-data.js.
